message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large, white, serif capital letters. The background is a dense, lush green landscape of tropical trees and foliage, covering almost the entire frame. Nestled within this thick greenery is a two-story structure with a brown tiled roof and white walls. A smaller, gazebo-like structure with a similar roof stands slightly lower and to the left of the main building.

Various lines of text are superimposed on the image. At the top left, yellow text reads "GERTAK SAMBAL ANAS URBANINGRUM." To the top right, yellow text reads "SKENARIO KREDIT LANCUNG BANK JABAR." Centered below the main title is smaller white text: "EDISI 4-10 MARET 2013." A red rectangular box with the white word "INVESTIGASI" is positioned above large, bold, white capital letters that read "PENGGEDE DI HULU CISADANE." Below this, smaller white text states: "Pejabat, artis, politikus menguasai lahan haram di Kawasan Taman Nasional Gunung Halimun-Salak." At the bottom left, a barcode and the price "RP 33.000" are visible. The left edge of the cover features a solid red vertical stripe.
